title: HVVC 2026–27 Tryout & Season FAQs
intro:
We’re so excited you’re considering joining the HVVC family for the 2026–27 club season! We can’t wait to welcome new and returning athletes, and we’ve put together answers to common questions to help your family prepare for the season ahead.

**Team information, financial commitment details, season dues and Scholarship information will be posted on our [Investment](/investment/) page by October 20.**

Coaching assignments and practice schedules are still being finalized, and we’ll share updates as they are confirmed.

questions.question: When and where are official tryouts?
questions.answer:
Tryouts will take place at **Adrienne C. Nelson High School**.

Division | Date | Tryout Time
11U & 12U | Sunday, November 8, 2026 | 8:30 to 10:30 AM
13U & 14U | Sunday, November 8, 2026 | 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM
15 & Over | Sunday, November 15, 2026 | 8:30 to 11:00 AM

Please review your registration confirmation for check-in instructions and required paperwork.

questions.question: How do I register?
questions.answer:
[Register for HVVC 2026–27 Tryouts](https://hvvc.leagueapps.com/events/5181386-hvvc-202627-tryout-registration).

Official tryout registration is separate from open gym and pre-tryout assessment registration. Attending an earlier event does not automatically register your athlete for tryouts.

questions.question: Which age division should my athlete register for?
questions.answer:
Age eligibility is based on your athlete’s birth date and the current USA Volleyball age definitions, rather than grade level alone.

[View the 2026–27 Age Definitions](https://cevaregion.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/FY27-Age-Definitions-Full.pdf).

If you’re unsure, email us with your athlete’s name and birth date so we can help identify the appropriate division.

questions.question: Can my athlete be considered for an older division?
questions.answer:
Yes, athletes may be considered for an older division when appropriate. Placement depends on eligibility, readiness, positional needs, and the best developmental fit.

Please let us know if your athlete is interested in being evaluated for more than one division so we can guide you through the process.

questions.question: Does my athlete need previous club experience?
questions.answer:
No! Athletes do not need previous club experience to try out. Coaches consider skill, athletic potential, effort, coachability, teamwork, and team needs.

Tryouts are competitive, and registration does not guarantee a roster spot.

questions.question: Does attending an open gym or receiving an assessment invitation guarantee a team spot?
questions.answer:
No. Open gyms and pre-tryout assessments help coaches get to know athletes and explore potential team fit. **Final team selections take place at official tryouts.**

Athletes who were not invited to an assessment are still welcome to register for official tryouts.

questions.question: What if my athlete was grouped with younger players at an open gym?
questions.answer: Open gym groupings are not final team placements. Groups may be organized for the needs of that session, and coaches continue evaluating athletes leading up to official tryouts.

questions.question: What teams will HVVC offer?
questions.answer:
Our current plans include girls’ teams in the **11U, 12U, 13U, 14U, 15U, 16U, and 18U divisions**, including two teams in both 13U and 14U.

Final team offerings depend on athlete turnout, coaching coverage, and roster needs. Team information will be released by October 20.

questions.question: Who will coach each team?
questions.answer: We’re being intentional about matching coaches with the athletes and teams they’ll support. Some assignments are still being finalized as we assess the best fit. Confirmed coaching information will be shared as it becomes available.

questions.question: How much will the season cost?
questions.answer:
**Season dues and team financial commitment details will be released by October 20**, giving families time to review the information before official tryouts.

Please review your team’s fee information for the total cost, commitment deposit, payment schedule, what is included, and any additional expenses.

questions.question: What commitment should families expect?
questions.answer:
Club volleyball involves both a time commitment and a financial commitment. Families should plan for regular practices, scheduled tournaments, and any travel listed for their team.

Before accepting a roster spot, please review the team schedule and financial agreement carefully. Acceptance includes completing the required commitment paperwork and paying the commitment deposit according to your offer instructions.

Deposit amounts and payment details will be included in the information released by October 20.

questions.question: Are scholarships available?
questions.answer:
Yes! HVVC offers need-based scholarship support. 2026-2027 scholarship application process and details **will be posted on our [Investment](/investment/) page by October 20**. Assistance is subject to available funding.

Families may also apply separately to the **CEVA Athlete Success Fund (CASF)**, which offers need-based awards of **$500 to $1,500 toward club dues**.

• **Applications are open now.**
• **Deadline:** November 30, 2026, at 3:00 PM. Late applications are not accepted.
• **Eligibility:** Athletes must commit to a team and upgrade their current USAV membership from a tryout membership by the deadline.
• **Application requirements:** USAV membership number, household financial information, a reference letter from someone outside the family, and four essay responses written by the athlete. CEVA does not accept AI-generated essay answers.
• **Decisions:** Applicants will hear back by December 21, 2026.
• **Funding:** Awards are paid directly to the club beginning in January 2027. They do not cover initial membership fees, tryout fees, or deposits.

[Learn more about the CEVA Athlete Success Fund](https://cevaregion.org/casf/) or [complete the scholarship application](https://cevaregion.org/casf-application/).

questions.question: Is a CEVA membership required?
questions.answer:
Yes. Athletes must have a current USA Volleyball/CEVA membership valid for tryouts, purchased separately from HVVC registration.

The **2026–27 CEVA Girls Team Tryout Membership costs $20 plus a credit card processing fee**. It covers tryouts, but must be upgraded to a full season membership before practices or tournaments. The tryout membership payment can be applied toward that upgrade.

[Purchase or review CEVA membership options](https://cevaregion.org/membership/).

questions.question: What should my athlete bring to tryouts?
questions.answer:
Bring water, volleyball shoes, knee pads, and comfortable athletic clothing. Please also bring your current USA Volleyball/CEVA membership card and a **completed and signed medical release form**.

[Download the USA Volleyball Player Medical Release Form](https://cevaregion.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/TEMPLATE-Medical-Release-WITHOUT-Notary-1-1.pdf).

Please complete the form legibly and have **both your athlete and a parent or guardian sign in all required areas** before bringing it to check-in. Follow any additional instructions in your registration confirmation.

questions.question: What if my athlete can’t attend official tryouts?
questions.answer:
Please email **hvvc@hvvcvolleyballclub.com** as soon as possible with your athlete’s name, age division, and scheduling conflict. We’ll work with you to explore available evaluation options.

**Please still register for official tryouts**, even if your athlete cannot attend. Makeup evaluations will be considered individually and depend on coaching availability and remaining roster openings.

questions.question: When and where will teams practice?
questions.answer: Teams are expected to practice twice per week. Practice days, times, and locations are being coordinated with local facilities and are subject to gym approval. Confirmed schedules will be shared as they become available.

questions.question: How long is the season, and will teams travel?
questions.answer:
The season begins after tryouts and runs through **CEVA Regionals:** April 25 / May 3 depending on team. Tournament schedules and travel commitments vary by team. **Team tournament schedules will be finalized and posted on our website by October 20.**

If an opportunity arises to extend the season, such as an additional tournament or a Nationals bid, we’ll review it with families and share the schedule and any additional costs before moving forward.

questions.question: Can I learn more before tryouts?
questions.answer:
Yes! Join our **Pre-Tryout Parent Meeting**:

• **Tuesday, October 20, 2026**
• **6:30 to 8:00 PM**
• **Beatrice Cannady Elementary, in the gym**

We’ll discuss the upcoming season, team expectations, financial commitments, and family questions.

questions.question: What if my question isn’t answered here?
questions.answer:
Email **hvvc@hvvcvolleyballclub.com**. We’re receiving a high volume of messages as we prepare for the season, but your questions are important to us. Sarah will respond as soon as possible.

[Visit the HVVC website](/) for club updates.
